title: Epsilon-uniformity obstruction for resolvent-smoothed coordinate cylinders
question: Can the fixed-epsilon resolvent-smoothed coordinate f_epsilon(q)=q/(1+epsilon*q^2) be used as an epsilon-uniform weighted cylinder approximating the raw coordinate as epsilon tends to zero?

model.form_bound: The R304 same-form multiplier bound is at least 2*(a^2/4)^m plus the gradient term, so it diverges as epsilon tends to zero for every fixed support m>=1.
model.approximation: The pointwise error is q-f_epsilon(q)=epsilon*q^3/(1+epsilon*q^2), which can vanish under a state M20 hypothesis while the weighted multiplier constant still diverges.

adversarial_review.check: Only the exact value f_a(a)=a/2 is needed for the lower bound; no unproved maximizer claim is used in the obstruction.
The divergence uses the already-closed R304 bound and the lower bound on M; it does not pretend that a different weighted norm cannot exist.
The M20 approximation coefficient tends to zero separately, but that fact is not conflated with a uniform form multiplier or common-algebra estimate.
The one-coordinate witness already diverges; larger products only strengthen the fixed-support obstruction and no thermodynamic statement is inferred.
The negative result targets only epsilon-uniform promotion through the R304 weighted multiplier route; alternative higher-weight or cutoff-dependent routes remain open.
No nonexistence theorem, common-alpha conclusion, OS/KMS/GNS result, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A conclusion follows.

lean_crosscheck.boundary: Lean checks exact rational witness and scaling arithmetic only; it does not formalize a supremum theorem, operator domains, alternative weights, or any QFT limit.

qft_interface.closed: A route-local obstruction: the R304 weighted multiplier constants cannot be epsilon-uniform when the resolvent smoothing is removed, despite a separate conditional M20 pointwise approximation.
qft_interface.open: Alternative higher-energy weights, cutoff-dependent algebras, second commutators, modular transfer, direct D/delta-D Cauchy, exhaustion, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum and Pre-A.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: Negative epsilon-uniformity result for one bounded-cylinder route only; no common infinite-volume dynamics or production-owner conclusion.

no_overclaim: This is a route-local scaling obstruction to promoting the fixed-epsilon R304 multiplier estimate uniformly to epsilon=0. It does not exclude other weighted algebras, cutoff-dependent constructions, or a different proof of common QFT dynamics.
